description: A path through a family of finite words fails to pass through its kernel exactly when it is one of its exceptional paths.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.kernel_remainder (T : Set (List ℕ)) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.body T \
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.body (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.kernel T) =
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.exceptional T
